note: Clean-room, Sentinel-authored from the CWE-89 definition. NOT derived from VulnHunterX templates.
questions: Is the flagged value derived from request/user input (query params, form/body, headers, path, or cookies)?
Is that value concatenated or f-string/%-interpolated into the SQL text, rather than passed as a bound parameter (?, :name) or via ORM query args?
Is there NO intervening validator, allow-list, integer/enum cast, or ORM parameterization between the input and the SQL sink?
keep_if: untrusted input reaches the SQL sink without parameterization or an equivalent guard
